title: Learning Experience Designer
job_description:
At ExtraHop, we're on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you'd like to spend the next chapter of your career, we'd love to hear from you.

Position Summary

As a Learning Experience Designer on the Digital Support and Education team, you will play a crucial role in designing and developing technical training materials to facilitate the implementation, use, administration, and support of our technology. You will collaborate with subject matter experts across ExtraHop to create delightful digital learning experiences optimized for comprehension, application, and retention, with an emphasis on engaging video content and motion graphics

Key Responsibilities

Develop tutorial and explainer videos, incorporating multimedia assets such as screen captures, motion graphics, animations, and voiceovers
Apply learning theory and instructional design best practices to produce course design documents and video scripts
Cultivate collaborative relationships with SMEs across ExtraHop to identify knowledge and skill gaps to address through training
Conduct independent research on course topics using internal and external resources
Create and deploy courses within the learning management system
Execute quality assurance reviews of new and revised courses and assessments
Update aging assets to ensure alignment with available and in-use product versions

Required Qualifications

Four-year degree or equivalent experience; background in adult education preferred
Proven ability to design instructional content for complex topics, with experience building self-paced learning materials tailored to external audiences and customers
Three years of hands-on video development/motion design experience using Adobe After Effects or similar programs
Three years of experience with Adobe Creative tools (After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, Audition)
Three years of experience with authoring tools (Storyline, Captivate, etc.)
Ability to quickly grasp technical concepts with minimal assistance
Excellent organizational, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
Team-focused attitude and experience translating customer needs into deliverables
Work cooperatively with others within the organization and other cross-functional stakeholders
Work well in fast-paced environments
Has predictable, reliable attendance

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in a high-growth tech company
Skilljar LMS administration experience
Technical certifications: Front-end development, UX, digital marketing, web analytics
Graphic, web, or UX/UI design portfolio of professional work available
Portfolio showcasing instructional videos, motion graphics, interactive courseware, and other digital learning content

Skills and Competencies

Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Customer-centric attitude and a genuine passion for technology and digital user enablement.
Strong visual storytelling and multimedia design skills, with the ability to use motion graphics and animation to make complex technical concepts engaging and easy to understand.
Professional presentation and delivery skills with enthusiasm. Charisma and passion for technology.
Foundational knowledge of IT environments, troubleshooting, and networking concepts.
Demonstrated ability to quickly learn complex technical concepts.

The base salary for this role is $75,000 - $85,000 + bonus + benefits

ABOUT EXTRAHOP




ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. Since 2007, ExtraHop has consistently helped organizations worldwide extract in-depth network telemetry and contextual insights, affirming its commitment to protecting and empowering the connected enterprise.

OUR VALUES

Our culture is rooted in our five Values. These set the expectations for how we work individually and collectively as a team.

Lead with Purpose: We are driven to deliver results that create a positive impact for our customers, partners, and colleagues.

Act with Integrity: We operate with transparency, authenticity, and always in the best interest of the company.

Find a Way: We are resourceful, tackle hard problems with a sense of urgency and ownership, and do what it takes to get the job done.

Innovate: We listen to customers, partners, and the market, and respectfully push boundaries and challenge the status quo.

Share Success: We run together, we win together. We value diverse perspectives, hold space for all voices, and achieve the best results as a team.

Flexible PTO, Sick Time Prorated Based on Date of Hire, and All Federal Holidays (US Only) + 3 Days of Paid Volunteer Time
Non-Commissioned Positions may be eligible to participate in the Annual Discretionary Bonus Plan
FSA and Dependent Care Accounts + EAP, where applicable
Educational Reimbursement
401k with Employer Match or Pension where applicable
Pet Insurance (US Only)
Parental Leave (US Only)
Hybrid and Remote Work Model
